content.text:
I made three small, targeted improvements to `0.html`:

- **Fixed compounding opacity**: `.hint` had `opacity: 0.85` nested inside `.speed-label` (also `opacity: 0.85`), making the hint text render at ~72% effective opacity instead of the intended 85% — reduced legibility. Set `.hint` to `opacity: 1` so it matches its parent's intended dimming.
- **Added `touch-action: manipulation`** to both buttons to remove the ~300ms tap delay and prevent accidental double-tap zoom on mobile.
- **Added a `title` tooltip** to the circle button so mouse users get a hint on hover, matching the existing `aria-label` for screen readers.

The rest of the file (reduced-motion handling, localStorage sync across tabs, ARIA live region for speed announcements) was already solid and didn't need changes.
